statements.impact_statement: The immutable application image compiles only the hash-pinned sqlite3.c shared library. SQLite shell.c, sqlite3recover.c, the sqlite3 CLI and its .recover/.shell/.system commands are not built or installed. This CLI-only command-injection vulnerability is not present in the shipped library. CI separately checks the actual library/source identity, absent CLI/recovery export and FTS5 regression; all other findings remain blocking.
